thread:
sam: Quick RFC follow-up: we need a small, authoritative rollout adoption playbook published with each release so clients can uniformly decide backoff/fallback.
maria: Agreed. Minimal signals: success_rate, p95_latency, error_budget_burn. tombstone must be authoritative.
kevin: Also include churn (new_model_fraction) and `fallback_order`. Clients should get FSM hints so SDKs stay consistent.
lisa: Can we include defaults for window and grace windows, plus jitter and probabilistic throttle params? saves guesswork.
sam: Proposal example (control-plane blob): {"signal":"success_rate","window_secs":86400,"threshold_pct":92,"grace_secs":1800,"fallback_order":["v1-quant","v0"],"tombstone_ts":null,"client_behavior":{"soft_throttle_pct":15,"jitter_pct":6,"fallback_windows":2}}
kevin: Important: tombstone_ts is monotonic and authoritative. Once set, clients must stop routing after tombstone+ttl. Also add `release_id` and `provenance` (manifest sha).
maria: Polling: prefer SSE for immediate updates, otherwise exponential backoff with min 30s, cap 5m. Tenant overrides allowed but bounded.
lisa: Suggested client FSM: INIT -> NORMAL. If metric < threshold for > grace_secs -> SOFT_THROTTLE (probabilistic with jitter). If persists for fallback_windows*window_secs -> FALLBACK to next variant. If tombstone -> HARD_FAIL -> route fallback only. Emit telemetry with reason_code and release_id.
kevin: Make throttles probabilistic and seeded per-client to avoid thundering herds. SDKs should expose seed option.
sam: Telemetry requirements: per-client decision events (seed, action, snapshot), sampled outputs for QA, all tied to release_id and manifest sha.
maria: Test plan: staging canary tenant, inject synthetic success_rate drop, verify FSM transitions and telemetry.
lisa: I'll own dashboards and staging runbook.
kevin: I can prototype Python/Node SDK changes.
sam: Action items: sam->RFC follow-up doc + schema PR; kevin->SDK prototype; lisa->staging run and dashboards; maria->add audit/provenance fields. ops-bot: reserve release_id prefix.
ops-bot: noted. reserved release_id prefix `adopt-1761`.
maria: I'll file backlog tickets unless anyone objects.
sam: No objections, thanks everyone :rocket:
